svg.title: Receiver error and the homodyne penalty

cc:Work.dc:title: Receiver error and the homodyne penalty
cc:Work.dc:description: Drive varied at fixed received fraction eta=0.0001. Ideal quantum nulling and the exact classical Wonham reference are compared with analytic bounds on optimal diffusive homodyne for the driven quantum source.
